description: This file contains unit tests for the EducationAPI class within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It tests various API endpoints such as retrieving all education entries, getting a specific entry, creating, updating, and deleting education records, using a testing framework that involves mock services and data providers.

classes.name: EducationAPITest
classes.description: A test class for the EducationAPI endpoints, extending a base test case with utility methods for API testing. Contains multiple test methods to verify API behavior with different data sets.
